text.tspan: Refugio: one personal search, step by step
Measured on the live site (2026-11-01, median of 5 searches): 486 ms from Search to the answer. The three calls after Geocode run in parallel, so they take as long as the slowest one.
Types an address and presses Search
POST /v2/routes: to the nearest refuge (from the open-data map), 3.6 km/h
Draws the 3 walking areas, the route and nearby places
Minutes from Amazon Location next to the open-data minutes
Per search: 6 billable requests (1 Geocode + 3 isolines + 1 route + 1 SearchNearby). A tap on the map skips Geocode. Results are drawn and discarded, never stored.
